'''Geomancy''' is a [[Lunar spells|lunar spell]] that allows the status of every single [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patch]] in [[Gielinor]] to be viewed, excluding ones used during [[quests]], as well as [[compost]] progress.

[[File:Geomancy interface.png|thumb|left|The Geomancy interface.]]
Players can view the following information about their farming patches via the interface that opens when the spell is cast:
*Crop type
*Growth stage
*Patch protection status
*Patch compost status
*Patch water status
*Available yield or minimum yield

{{clear|left}}

The spell continuously checks the status of farming patches for as long as the spell interface is left open; it does not need to be cast again to update.
